email.title: Email accounts
email.description: Connect mailboxes, organize correspondence and prepare replies with your Scribe models.
email.credentialsPrivate: Credentials are stored separately from pipelines. Editing this connection does not require permission to reveal existing credentials.
email.foldersHelp: Separate folder names with commas. IMAP always uses TLS on port 993.
email.rotationHelp: Leave the login blank to keep it when replacing the password. Enter both fields when changing the login or mail servers.
email.ingestHelp: Requires an operator-configured ingestion identity and a published pipeline with the Email accounts source.
email.saveError: The change could not be saved. Check the required fields and your permissions, then try again.
email.loadError: Email data could not be loaded. Check your connection and permissions.
email.accessHelp: Grant rights to members of this organization. Pipeline access never grants access to this connection.
email.secretRightHelp: Reveal credentials is a separate permission. A member can edit or delete a connection without seeing its existing credentials. The owner controls permission delegation.
email.revokeHelp: Clear every permission to revoke this member’s access. Select an existing member above to edit their rights.
email.profileHelp: Choose a local or API model and registered Skills. An equivalent configured model is selected automatically if needed. Email content cannot grant tools or sending permissions.
email.fallbackHelp: Comma-separated aliases. Only these models may replace an unavailable primary model.
email.allowedSendersHelp: Exact email addresses, separated by commas. Automatic replies go only to the original sender.
email.automaticWarning: Automatic sending is explicitly authorized for these senders only. Mailing lists, automated messages, attachments and other recipients require human review. All actions are audited.
email.approvalHelp: Approval applies to the exact sender, recipients, body and attachments. Every edit clears approval. Sending requires a separate permission.
email.subject: Subject
email.attachmentHelp: Up to 16 attachments; 8 MiB per file and 12 MiB per outgoing message.
email.attachmentError: The attachment could not be added or exceeds the size limit.
email.noMessagesHelp: Test the connection and synchronize. New messages appear after the next collection. Search applies to the displayed page.
email.uncertain: Delivery may already have occurred. Verify the provider’s delivery logs using this Message-ID before composing another message. Automatic retry is blocked.
email.actionError: The operation could not be completed. Check your permissions, connection settings and current status.
email.sendError: Sending did not complete normally. Review delivery status before trying any further action.
email.consentHelp: Enter the mailbox address, then grant access directly with the provider. Galadril stores the returned tokens encrypted.
email.consentError: Email authorization did not complete. Start a new connection request and check the configured mailbox address.
email.noAccountsHelp: Use Gmail, Outlook or a TLS-enabled IMAP/SMTP account. Connections stay private until you grant access.
email.revealHelp: Only the login identifier is shown. Passwords and tokens can be replaced, never read back.
email.deleteHelp: This removes saved credentials, synchronized mail and drafts from Galadril. It does not delete mail on your provider.
email.senderLimit: Maximum automatic replies per sender in 24 hours
email.senderLimitHelp: Optional. Leave empty to allow replies to different messages within your global daily limit.
email.onePerThread: Send only one automatic acknowledgment per conversation
email.onePerThreadHelp: Uses the email References and In-Reply-To headers. Distinct conversations remain independent.
email.initialSyncHelp: Applies to folders without a checkpoint. Review automatic replies before importing history.

discovery.help: Enter a domain or email address, then leave this field to detect its servers.
discovery.review: Servers published by this domain are listed below. Review them before applying; no credentials are sent during discovery.
discovery.applied: Detected servers applied. Enter your own email address and sign-in details to save the connection.
discovery.error: Email server discovery failed. Check the domain and retry, or enter the servers manually.

imapStatus.absent: No secure IMAP service was published. Enter its server manually.
imapStatus.unavailable: IMAP discovery is temporarily unavailable. Retry or enter its server manually.
imapStatus.unsupported: The published IMAP service uses an unsupported port. Enter a server with TLS on port 993.
imapStatus.blocked: The published IMAP server is not allowed by the deployment network policy.

smtpStatus.absent: No secure SMTP service was published. Enter its server manually.
smtpStatus.unavailable: SMTP discovery is temporarily unavailable. Retry or enter its server manually.
smtpStatus.unsupported: The published SMTP service uses an unsupported port. Use TLS on 465 or STARTTLS on 587.
smtpStatus.blocked: The published SMTP server is not allowed by the deployment network policy.

discovery.manualFallback: Automatic detection could not finish. You can retry with Back, or enter the server settings below.

wizard.description: Enter your email address. We will look for secure server settings before asking for credentials.
wizard.addressHelp: Only the domain is used for discovery. No password is requested or sent at this step.
wizard.manualHelp: Automatic configuration is incomplete. Enter the servers supplied by your email provider.
wizard.oauthHelp: Sign in with your provider without sharing your account password with Galadril.
wizard.oauthNotConfigured: OAuth for this provider has not been configured by the deployment administrator. You can use a provider-issued app password if your account supports it.
wizard.usernameHelp: Check your login identifier. Your institution may use a student or staff ID instead of your email address.
wizard.appPassword: Use a Google app password, not your regular Google account password.
wizard.defaults: New messages only. Automatic sending is off.
wizard.invalidServers: Enter server hostnames such as imap.example.org, without https://, ports or paths.
wizard.serversUnavailable: The secure mail servers could not be verified. Check the hostnames, TLS settings and network access, then retry.

email.authenticationFailed: The mail server rejected the saved login. Edit the connection and enter the working username and password again. No messages were sent.
email.signatureHelp: HTML formatting is supported. Scripts, embedded frames and remote images are removed.
email.signatureFieldsHelp: Preview values are examples. Each message has a stable reference carried into ingestion and generated replies. Fields are filled when sending.

chat.help: Review the recipients, subject and content. Your sending account is chosen only when you send.
chat.noSender: Connect an enabled account with permission to prepare, approve and send email.
chat.failed: The email could not be sent. Check the connection or review its delivery status in Email settings before retrying.
chat.uncertain: Delivery is still in progress or could not be confirmed. Review it in Email settings; no second email will be sent automatically.
chat.statusUnavailable: Delivery status could not be verified. Check its status before sending this proposal.

email.chooseAccountHelp: Choose an account to manage its connection, messages and replies.
email.connectionSectionHelp: Secure servers used to receive and send your messages.
email.searchHelp: Search collected titles, senders or message text. Minor typos and missing accents are accepted.
email.noSearchResultsHelp: Try another word or sender. Search includes only messages already collected by Galadril.
email.searchLimited: Use more specific words to check additional approximate matches.

thread.title: Correspondence thread
thread.failed: The correspondence could not be loaded. Check your access and retry.
thread.pipelineHistory: Pipeline links show up to 100 recent executions you have permission to view.
thread.tracesUnavailable: Pipeline history is unavailable. The correspondence remains visible.
thread.partial: This view contains up to 128 messages. Older correspondence is indexed progressively.

tracking.help: Records the time and observed IP whenever the tracking image is loaded. Image blocking, privacy proxies and automatic scans can hide or create signals. With multiple recipients, a signal cannot identify who read the email.
tracking.unconfigured: Opening tracking requires the deployment administrator to configure a public HTTPS address. It stays disabled by default.
tracking.title: Opening signals
tracking.failed: Opening signals could not be loaded. Check your connection and permissions.
tracking.empty: No opening signals have been recorded.
tracking.retention: Signals are retained for 90 days, with up to 1,000 signals per delivery. Times use your browser's time zone. IPs can belong to a mail privacy proxy.

email.optionalImap: Optional. Leave blank to use this connection only for sending email.
email.sendingOnlyHelp: This connection sends email only. It will not collect messages. Drafts require approval before sending.

documents.deleteExplanation: {count} documents will no longer be available in this library or to Pengolo.
documents.partialFailure: Some documents could not be processed. Failed documents remain selected; check your access and retry.
documents.downloadError: Download could not finish. Retry with fewer documents (up to 100 MB per archive).
documents.chatLimit: Select up to eight ready documents to start a chat.
documents.reindexError: Indexing could not be requested. Check your permissions and retry.
documents.emptyHelp: Keep documents here to use them again in Pengolo.
documents.name: Name
documents.previewUnavailable: Preview could not be opened. Check your access, retry, or download the document. Supported previews include PDF, images and plain text up to 50 MB.

projectActions.description: Delete {name}? Its conversations and documents will no longer be accessible through this project. Existing retention rules still apply.
projectActions.failed: The project could not be deleted. Check your permissions or refresh it before retrying.
